doc_leonardo.title: Leonardo da Vinci
section_texts: Leonardo da Vinci was an Italian Renaissance painter, engineer, and inventor.
He is widely associated with works such as the Mona Lisa and The Last Supper.
When a question asks who painted a famous Renaissance artwork, Leonardo da Vinci can be a relevant answer in some cases.

doc_cat.title: Cat
section_texts: The cat is a small domesticated carnivorous mammal.
Cats are common pets and are known for whiskers, pointed ears, and agile movement.

doc_eiffel.title: Eiffel Tower
section_texts: The Eiffel Tower is a wrought-iron tower in Paris, France.
It is one of the most recognizable landmarks in the world.
